## Report: Position Lock Feature Integration Map

### 1. **Auto-adjust Layout Button** — Line 2520-2569
- **File:line**: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Operation/Polyglot/client/src/pages/OrgChart.tsx:2520-2540`
- **Click handler**: Anonymous async function at line 2521
- **Function called**: `resetOrgChartPositions()` (line 2527) via lazy import from `../lib/api`
- **What it mutates**: 
  - Calls `resetOrgChartPositions()` which DELETEs only unlocked positions from the server (lines 2525-2528)
  - Reloads `positionOverrides` state via `reloadPositions()` (line 2531)
  - Sets `edges` back to `initialEdges` (line 2538)
  - Server-side deletion respects locked entries (DELETE only clears `locked: false` rows)

### 2. **Position Computation** — Deterministic + Stored State
- **Layout strategy**: Positions are **computed deterministically** from org hierarchy each render via `computeDepartmentLayout()` (line 2220)
- **Position storage**: Stored **in-memory state** + **server database** (NOT localStorage, NOT registry.json)
  - **State**: `positionOverrides` at line 2205 — `Record<string, { x: number; y: number; locked: boolean }>`
  - **Server persistence**: `/org-chart/positions` endpoint (GET/POST/DELETE)
  - **Load on mount**: `reloadPositions()` at line 2206 fetches server positions via `getOrgChartPositions()` 
  - **Overlay pattern** (line 2227-2239): Raw computed nodes overlaid with `positionOverrides` (x, y, locked flag)

### 3. **Drag-and-Drop Support** — Full Manual Positioning
- **Yes, cards are draggable** (line 2481: `nodesDraggable`)
- **Drag position persistence** (lines 2461-2478):
  - `onNodeDragStop` handler saves position to server via `saveOrgChartPositions()`
  - Updates local `positionOverrides` state with `locked: prev[node.id]?.locked ?? false` (preserves lock flag)
- **Non-draggable when locked**: Line 2235 — `draggable: !o.locked` (locked nodes get `draggable=false`)
- **Plug-in point for manual positions**: Already wired up — dragged positions auto-save to `/org-chart/positions` POST endpoint

### 4. **Per-Card Render** — Individual Agent Card
- **Leadership card (tree root)**: Line 773-875
  - `OrgLeaderNode()` component renders white card with avatar, name, title, badges
  - **No lock icon** on card itself (yet)
  - Full card is a button (line 783-867) that triggers selection via context
  
- **Department/Member card rows**: Line 992-1070 (`renderMemberRow()`)
  - Member rows rendered as buttons (line 1017-1066) inside department nodes
  - **No lock icon** on individual member cards either
  - Both use `OrgSelectContext` to trigger detail panel
  
- **Lock icon location**: Currently **only in Detail Panel** (line 2012-2031)
  - Lines 2012-2014: Lock icon badge in header when `locked===true`
  - Lines 2021-2033: Toggle lock button (Lock/Unlock icons, handler at line 2602)

### 5. **State Management** — Context + Zustand hybrid
- **Framework**: React Context (not Zustand)
  - `OrgSelectContext` (line 67-70): manages `selectedId` string + `onSelect(id)` callback
  - `positionOverrides` state (line 2205): local `useState` in `TreeViewInner` component
  - Position loading (line 2206-2217): `useCallback` + `useEffect` pattern
- **Lock state belongs**: In `positionOverrides[nodeId].locked` (boolean flag, line 2205, 2212)

### 6. **Persistence Options** — Server-First, No localStorage
- **API endpoints** (lib/api.ts:943-963):
  - `GET /org-chart/positions` — fetches all saved positions + lock state
  - `POST /org-chart/positions` — saves positions array `[{nodeId, x, y}]`
  - `DELETE /org-chart/positions[?includeLocked=1]` — clears unlocked positions (or all if flag set)
  - `POST /org-chart/positions/{nodeId}/lock` — toggle lock for one node
- **No localStorage**: No helpers found; positions live in server DB only
- **Ready-to-use PUT endpoint**: N/A — uses POST for individual saves + DELETE for batch clear

### 7. **Existing Lock UI** — Detail Panel Header
- **File:line**: `OrgChart.tsx:2012-2031`
- **Lock control today**: Toggles `locked` boolean per node via `onToggleLock` callback
  - Line 2024: title shows lock/unlock intent
  - Line 2026: button className conditionally shows amber highlight when locked
  - Line 2031: renders `Lock` (locked) or `Unlock` (unlocked) icon
- **What it does**: 
  - Calls `toggleOrgChartLock(selectedNodeData.id, next)` (line 2615)
  - If locking a node with no prior saved position, auto-saves current position first (line 2609-2613)
  - Reloads positions, updates state, shows toast feedback (line 2616-2617)

---

**Key Design Insight**: The feature is **90% built**. Lock state is already persisted per card, respects auto-adjust logic (locked cards survive reset), and toggles via the detail panel. To add **per-card lock buttons**: render a small lock/unlock button on `OrgLeaderNode` (line 788 card area) and `renderMemberRow` (line 1017 button area), wired to the same `onToggleLock` callback passed to detail panel.
